word-problems-100-skill-01.skill: Add To and Take From Problems
word-problems-100-skill-01.target: I can solve add-to and take-from problems when the result, the change, or the start is unknown.
word-problems-100-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can solve add-to and take-from problems when the result, the change, or the start is unknown.
word-problems-100-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Using key words (“more” means add) instead of the story, especially when the start is unknown. Try this: Act out or draw the story; mark the part that is unknown with a box, then write the equation.

word-problems-100-skill-02.skill: Put Together and Take Apart Problems
word-problems-100-skill-02.target: I can solve put-together and take-apart problems when the total or one part is unknown.
word-problems-100-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can solve put-together and take-apart problems when the total or one part is unknown.
word-problems-100-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding the total and the known part when a part is unknown. Try this: Draw a part-part-whole bar model and label the whole and each part before computing.

word-problems-100-skill-03.target: I can solve compare problems that ask how many more or how many fewer, or the bigger or smaller amount.
word-problems-100-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can solve compare problems that ask how many more or how many fewer, or the bigger or smaller amount.
word-problems-100-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding whenever the word “more” appears, even when the bigger amount is given. Try this: Draw two bars lined up; the difference is the extra part of the longer bar.

word-problems-100-skill-04.target: I can solve two-step word problems within 100 and write an equation with a symbol for the unknown.
word-problems-100-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can solve two-step word problems within 100 and write an equation with a symbol for the unknown.
word-problems-100-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Doing only the first step, or using all the numbers with one operation. Try this: Ask “What do I need to know first?” and write a separate equation for each step.
